description: Three-phase power analyzer for 96 mm panels: voltages, currents, powers, power factors, frequency, THD, energies, demand, run hours and setup
source: Carlo Gavazzi, WM15 Communication Protocol, version 1.2, 2019-12-20

sources.title: WM15 Communication Protocol
sources.note: found through competitor catalogues (Easy Modbus / Voltrus / Proxus); register tables re-read from the manufacturer's document

notes: Modbus RTU over RS485. Functions 03h and 04h read the same registers (input and holding are one table); 06h and 10h write. Up to 125 registers per read.
Addresses are the physical addresses of the manual (the 3xxxxx/4xxxxx Modicon numbers less 300001).
32-bit and 64-bit values have the least significant word first (word order LSW->MSW); bytes in a word are MSB first.
Scaling is the manual's 'Value weight': the register value divided by the weight.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
